proof_scope: Strict Pydantic explainers, MATCHED/AMBIGUOUS/NO_MATCH routing and reducer/receipt contracts, plus live Chrome/HTTP external-update synchronization with replayed questions and fault-injected response ordering. Browser case owns disposable tab/API/preview processes. No microphone, VS Code, Excalidraw board or debugger execution proof.

cases.name: sample-command-live-entrypoint
command:
cd .. && T=$(mktemp -d) && ./run.sh sample --output $T/explainers.jsonl && ./run.sh cockpit-proof $T/explainers.jsonl --question 'A worker crashes before success; what prevents incomplete release?' | tee $T/proof.json && python3 - <<'PY' $T/proof.json
import json,sys
p=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert p['status']=='PASS' and p['assertions']['projection_revisions_equal']
print('EXPLAIN_PROJECT_SAMPLE_ENTRYPOINT_OK')
PY

cases.name: live-evidence-intake-deduplicates
command:
cd .. && PYTHONPATH=scripts uv run --with pydantic --with httpx --with loguru python3 - <<'PY'
from explain_project_core.catalog import sample_record
from explain_project_core.server import CockpitSession
from fixtures.cockpit_contract_eval import candidate_payload

session = CockpitSession([sample_record()], 'http://127.0.0.1:8601')
accepted = session.intake_live_evidence(candidate_payload())
duplicate = session.intake_live_evidence(candidate_payload())
assert accepted.status == 'ACCEPTED'
assert accepted.state.revision == 1
assert accepted.state.question.source == 'live_evidence_replay'
assert duplicate.status == 'DUPLICATE'
assert duplicate.state.revision == accepted.state.revision
print('EXPLAIN_PROJECT_LIVE_INTAKE_DEDUP_OK')
PY

cases.name: interaction-manifest-qid-only
command:
cd .. && ./run.sh interaction-manifest --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8766 | tee /tmp/explain-project-interaction-manifest.json && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
m=json.load(open('/tmp/explain-project-interaction-manifest.json'))
selectors=[i['target'] for s in m['surfaces'] for e in s['elements'] for i in e['interactions']]
assert m['discovery']['qid_only_executable_selectors'] is True
assert "[data-qid='cockpit:explainer:slider']" in selectors
assert "[data-qid='cockpit:explainer:page-input']" in selectors
assert all(sel.startswith('[data-qid=') for sel in selectors)
print('EXPLAIN_PROJECT_INTERACTION_MANIFEST_OK')
PY
